scripts.check:fast: cd src-tauri && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && ! grep -rlE --include='*.rs' '#\[([a-z_]+::)?test\]' src | grep -v '/tests[.]rs$' && ! grep -rl --include='*.rs' 'unsafe_code' src | grep -v '^src/macos/' && cd .. && ! grep -rnE '@ts-(ignore|expect-error)' src && tsc --noEmit
scripts.check:task: pnpm check:fast && pnpm test && cd src-tauri && cargo test && cargo llvm-cov --fail-under-lines 80 --ignore-filename-regex 'src/(macos/|(main|lib|tray|commands)[.]rs)|/tests[.]rs$' && cargo deny check advisories licenses && cd .. && pnpm audit --audit-level high && gitleaks git --redact --no-banner && gitleaks git --pre-commit --redact --no-banner && gitleaks git --pre-commit --staged --redact --no-banner
